title: Pattern-local shadows and the parent scope
teaches: Hap expressions see pacer's frame environment under three pattern-local names. tick is the hap's cycle onset, not the frame tick; cycle and seed are pattern-local too, while beat and every control resolve through the parent scope.
observe: clock follows beat across the bar wrap: 0, 2, 3, 8, 12.
onset stays 0 all through cycle 0 and jumps to 720720 in cycle 1.
swayx2 reads the env-only control sway and writes 0.5.
Only swayx2 writes; the control itself has no target.
